message.subject: Agfa + protective film partnership idea
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Congrats on the recent Pinnacle Awards—impressive recognition for the new printer lineup.

I've been thinking about how printer manufacturers like Agfa differentiate when competing against HP and Canon at shows like FESPA. One gap I've noticed: even perfect prints fail when customers choose the wrong overlaminate, but that failure reflects back on the printer brand.

We work with several equipment manufacturers to become their validated overlaminate partner—essentially extending your quality control beyond the print itself. Would you be open to a brief conversation about what a technical partnership might look like?

Happy to share how others have structured this.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Agfa recently won 2025 Pinnacle Product Awards and competes directly with HP, Canon, and Epson at major trade shows, signaling they compete on premium positioning and need clear differentiation
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Strategic partnership that extends Agfa's quality control through validated overlaminate recommendations, solving the problem that customer's poor material choices damage Agfa's brand reputation
